title: Pip and the Little Frog
checkpoint: Phase 1 (Introduction) — a wordless story for sharing and talking through together; there are no sounds to decode yet.
note_for_grown_ups: Pip's very first adventure has no words at all — share it together and talk through what is happening on each page. There is nothing to decode yet; this is about enjoying a story together and finding your own words for what you both notice.

pages.talk_prompt: Pip is flying low over the pond — what do you think he has spotted down in the reeds?
pages.illustration: Pip the sand-brown sparrow flying low over a green pond, looking down at something moving in the reeds at the water's edge.

pages.talk_prompt: Look closely at the little frog — how do you think it is feeling, tangled up like that?
pages.illustration: A small green froglet tangled in strands of pale green pondweed at the water's edge, eyes wide, struggling.

pages.talk_prompt: Pip has landed right next to the frog — what do you think he is about to do?
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow landed beside the tangled froglet, head tilted, working out how to help.

pages.talk_prompt: Pip is pulling at the weeds with his beak — do you think it is working?
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tugging a strand of pale green pondweed loose with his beak while the froglet watches.

pages.talk_prompt: The frog is free at last — where do you think it will go now?
pages.illustration: The small green froglet, now free of the weeds, hopping onto a round lily pad.

pages.talk_prompt: Pip and the little frog are sitting together in the sun now — how do you think they both feel?
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and the small green froglet sitting together on a lily pad in warm sunshine, both relaxed and happy.
